Case: the spec home is reachable and one well-formed classification exists
Asserts: A4
Home: reachable
Records: 1
Expect: clean
Findings: 0
Why: The negative control. Without it, a detector that fired on the mere
  existence of a classification record would satisfy A2 and A3 and be
  worthless - every repo that has ever classified anything would be a finding.
  Reachable home, valid commit, valid hash: nothing to say.
